    Plot cohort log(mu) estimates against healthy HCA posterior draws

    plot_cohort_vs_hca.Rd

    Visualises cohort log(mu) estimates against healthy HCA posterior draws. Pass a data frame with at least `group` and `log_mu` (and optionally `se`, `p_value`, `direction`).

    plot_cohort_vs_hca(
  hca_draws,
  cohort_est,
  exclude_groups = character(0),
  show_se = TRUE,
  stagger_heights = TRUE,
  colour_by = c("cohort", "direction"),
  cohort_palette = NULL,
  annotate = c("group", "p_value"),
  fill = "#4C78A8",
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL
)

    Arguments

    hca_draws

    Posterior draws from [expression_draws()]. Must use `quantity = "linpred"` because cohort tests are on log(mu).

    cohort_est

    Data frame with cohort estimates (`group`, `log_mu`, ...).

    exclude_groups

    Character vector of cohort labels to omit.

    show_se

    If `TRUE`, draw horizontal error bars for cohort `log_mu +/- se`.

    stagger_heights

    If `TRUE`, place each cohort marker at a different height above the density to reduce overlap.

    colour_by

    Colour cohort markers by `"cohort"` or `"direction"`.

    cohort_palette

    Optional colour vector when `colour_by = "cohort"`.

    annotate

    Character vector of label fields: `"group"`, `"p_value"`, `"direction"`, `"empirical_rank"`, `"method"`.

    fill

    Fill colour for the HCA density curve.

    title

    Plot title. Default is built from gene / cell-type metadata.

    subtitle

    Optional subtitle.

    Value

    A `ggplot` object.
